headline: Bundesbank Projects Sharp Rise in German Inflation at Year-End
summary: Germany's central bank warned in its monthly report that inflation is expected to accelerate significantly around the turn of the year as energy tax relief measures expire.
why: The Deutsche Bundesbank is Germany's central bank and an influential voice within the European Central Bank Governing Council.

impacts.name: German 10-year Bund yield
impacts.why: Forecasts of rising year-end inflation support higher European government bond yields.
